title: Stationary monotonicity identity, existence and upper semicontinuity of the density (Simon 3.6–3.11)
statement: Assume (GF). Then StationaryMonotonicity holds (for V stationary in open U and B_R(ξ) ⊆ U: ρ^{-n}μ_V(B_ρ) − σ^{-n}μ_V(B_σ) = ∫_{B_ρ∖B_σ} q_ξ|x − ξ|^{-n}dμ_V for 0 < σ ≤ ρ < R; ρ ↦ ρ^{-n}μ_V(B_ρ) is nondecreasing on (0, R); and for 0 < ρ < R the integrand is μ_V-integrable on B_ρ with (ω_nρⁿ)^{-1}μ_V(B_ρ) − Θⁿ(μ_V, ξ) = ω_n^{-1}∫_{B_ρ} q_ξ|x − ξ|^{-n}dμ_V), and StationaryDensity holds (Θⁿ(μ_V, ·) exists at every point of U and is upper semicontinuous on U).
lean_statement: (∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ), 0 < n → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts V.weight ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, Module.finrank ℝ (V.tangentSpace x) = n) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x ↦ (V.tangentSpace x).starProjection) V.weight) → StationaryMonotonicity ∧ StationaryDensity
